routes.description: Where the browser starts: the router, the root document from web-platform, made a PWA, the offline page, and one thin route for each Place. The router reaches the routes through the generated route tree, so nothing imports them

worker.description: The Worker: /rpc is core's Backend on its cloud services, the D1 database and the sign-in service; everything else is the app

infra.description: Deployable resources, composed by alchemy.run.ts: the D1 database, core's ledger table on it, and the Worker

screens.description: What the user sees in a browser: the shell around every Place, each Place, the sheets over them, and the parts they share
The shell holds every sheet; each Place is its own module the routes open; all of them draw with the shared parts, and Entries opens the Account sheet too

app.description: Ledger in the browser, made once from core on the browser's Platform, with the theme: what every screen uses for sign-in, the session and Settings

platform.description: The browser as Ledger's Platform for auth-toolkit's createApp: tables and Std Sync in IndexedDB, cookie sign-in at the sign-in service, the API at this origin, the window's network and visibility, and other tabs over a BroadcastChannel

stage.description: Where this stage's sign-in service is, and the audience the cloud Backend checks

ledger-web.description: Read top-down: the routes open the screens, which use Ledger from app.ts, made on the browser's Platform; the Worker runs core's Backend on its cloud services, beside the infra. Everything shared with the Expo app is in @ledger/core
